# Roadmap

Feature roll-up for the tracked features.

## State Definitions

| State | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Ready | Specified; not started. |
| In Progress | Active now. |
| In Review | PR open; awaiting merge/verification. |
| Done | Command + commit evidence recorded in `Actual Condition`. |
